goal: Preserve the current native editor while normalizing every panel onto one dock/chrome/input model.

dockRegistryTarget.title: visible label
dockRegistryTarget.inputPriority: modal > popup > menu > workspace tabs > dock chrome > panel body > canvas gestures

polishRules: Use editor_theme tokens instead of local color literals where safe.
No panel may trap top-level workspace navigation.
Every panel error state must keep close/reload/navigation available.
Reset Layout must restore a usable default.
